meta.title: Docwright document generation
meta.description: Generates documents that carry structured information — use this plugin when the document content requires strict validation. The plugin takes the Harness philosophy as its foundation and uses JSON as the output format, forming a generate, validate and repair closed loop; it supports param configuration and hot reload, and staged generation during processing. The document-generation methods and resources for a specific scenario are called a scenario pack (pack). The skill also provides ways to find and author packs.
